tasks.number_or_label: 4 · The deviation in FAR area allowed as per Table-2B shall be limited to a maximum
tasks.text_or_value: The deviation in FAR area allowed as per Table-2B shall be limited to a maximum of 5% of the permissible FAR for buildings which have utilized additional FAR (TDR/ PFAR).
